To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

layered coding is more efficient than multiple description coding for rate-distortion optimized transmission schemes, while multiple description coding is more efficient for non rate-distortion optimized schemes.
multiple description coding outperforms layered coding for video transmission over error-prone networks if the packet transmission schedule is not optimized in a rate distortion sense.

multiple description coding is better than layered coding when there are no transmission constraints, and layered coding is better than multiple description coding when there are transmission constraints, and when the transmission constraints are not rate-distortional.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the performance of layered and multiple description coding in a specific application scenario, i.e. streaming video over error prone packet switched networks.
the performance of layered coding and multiple description coding for video streaming applications over multiple error-prone packet-switched networks.
a comparison of layered coding and multiple description coding.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
multiple description coding and layering are not competing technologies, but that they are complementary.
the performance of multiple description coding is better than that of layered coding for scenarios where the network is not rate-distortion aware.
multiple description coding is a better choice than layered coding for scenarios where the transmission schedule can be optimized in the rate-distortion sense.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, given specific implementation of multiple description coding, layered coding can be a better choice for video streaming over packet-switched networks if the network path diversity is not exploited.
layered coding provides a more robust transmission scheme for video streaming over packet switched networks.
, given a fixed number of network paths, layered coding is a better option than multiple description coding for streaming of video content.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the relative performance between layered and multiple description coding depends on the employed transmission schemes.
the performance comparison of multiple description coding with layered coding is highly implementation dependent and should be performed on a case by case basis.
the performance of specific layered coding and multiple description coding schemes depends on the transmission schemes and on the network topology.
